name: CSV 转 YAML 转换器

map.在配置、CI、Kubernetes 等场景常需要在 CSV 与 YAML 之间互: Configs, CI pipelines and Kubernetes manifests often need CSV and YAML converted back and forth. The first row is treated as field names to build key-value pairs; tick "No header" if the first row should also be part of the array.
map.：先按 CSV 解析为二维表，再按 YAML 缩进规则序列化为列表与映射。: : parse the CSV into a two-dimensional table first, then serialize it into lists and mappings following YAML indentation rules.
map.：YAML 依赖缩进表达层级，不能用 Tab，同层级必须严格对齐。: : YAML expresses hierarchy through indentation — tabs are not allowed, and entries at the same level must align exactly.
map.的值会被推断为布尔或数字，需加引号保留字符串。: are inferred as booleans or numbers, so quote them to keep them as strings.
map.：配置文件生成、数据迁移与人工编辑场景。: : generating config files, migrating data, and any case where a human edits the result.
map.逗号、换行、双引号会被自动按 RFC 4180 处理；包含逗号/换行的字段请用双: Commas, newlines and double quotes are handled per RFC 4180 automatically; wrap any field containing a comma or newline in double quotes.
map.无表头模式输出为嵌套数组，有表头模式输出为键值对列表。: Headerless mode outputs nested arrays; header mode outputs a list of key-value pairs.
map.值为空时输出空字符串；如需 null 可后续手动替换。: Empty values are emitted as empty strings; replace them with null afterwards if you need to.
map.本工具输出采用 2 空格缩进的标准 YAML；引号由 JSON.stringif: This tool emits standard YAML with 2-space indentation; quoting is handled by JSON.stringify for special characters, so common YAML parsers read the output directly.
map.📚 深度解析：CSV to YAML Converter: 📚 Deep Dive: CSV to YAML Converter
map.CSV 转 YAML 便于配置。: CSV to YAML makes configuration easier.
map.把表格数据转成配置片段写进 CI 或部署清单，比手写 YAML 缩进更不易出错。: Turn tabular data into config snippets for a CI pipeline or deployment manifest — less error-prone than hand-writing YAML indentation.
map.CSV 两行 → YAML 列表 `- {a: \"1\", b: \"2\"}: Two CSV rows → a YAML list `- {a: "1", b: "2"}`.
map.大 CSV 转 YAML 慢吗？: Is a large CSV slow to convert to YAML?
map.行数很大时 YAML 体积与解析都较重。: With very many rows, YAML becomes heavy both in size and in parsing.
map.转换后缩进乱了怎么办？: The indentation came out wrong — what now?
map.YAML 依赖缩进表达层级，常见问题是值里含冒号、前导空格或制表符，导致被当作嵌: YAML expresses hierarchy through indentation, and the usual culprit is a value containing a colon, leading spaces or a tab, which then reads as a nested structure or an illegal character. Quote any field containing special characters during conversion, and make sure indentation uses spaces rather than tabs — the YAML specification forbids tabs.
